purpose: Estimate conditional forward distributions after observable participation shocks, breakouts, retests and rebreakouts without claiming direct identification of main-player orders.

target_semantics.t_plus_one: entry is path day 1; legal sale and first-hit paths start at path day 2; H1 terminal return is shadow-only

mathematical_priors: scale-normalized participation shocks are observable proxies for attention and order-flow pressure, not latent trader identity
continuation requires conditional dependence after a shock; volatility alone raises MFE even at zero drift
a breakout is a state transition relative to a prior resistance level, while a retest tests conditional support
date-equal clustered inference is preferred because cross-sectional rows on one day share market shocks
